title: Expose susi os capabilities revoke CLI subcommand for signed delegation envelopes
goal: Complete CLI parity for host-signed Mandate 73 `susi-delegation/v1` envelope revocation: add `OsCapabilitiesAction::Revoke` (`susi os capabilities revoke <id> [--json]`) in `crates/susi-cli-defs/src/os.rs` and `src/cli/os_cli.rs` backed by `CapabilityRegistry::revoke_delegation`, synchronize `tests/fixtures/cli_help_snapshot.txt`, add unit tests covering blank-id refusal, live revocation, idempotency, and post-revocation `dispatch_nested` refusal, and update `docs/recursive-delegation.md`.

results.clippy_check: pass (0 warnings across susi-cli-defs and susi --bin susi)

limitations: Because the replay and revocation ledger is per process, `susi os capabilities revoke <id>` revokes an envelope in the CLI process's ledger; daemon-hosted runs are revoked through `daemon.harness` (`revoke_delegation`) or `serve_nested` (`action: "revoke"`).
Windows x86_64 release qualification remains owed on a native Windows host.
